title: ConstructHandoffEnvelope
description: Per-stage handoff envelope for the Construct Bounded-Context Runtime Substrate (cycle-construct-bounded-context, SDD §3.2). Captures the stage's verdict on its own work: status, produced outputs, summary, next-allowed reads, partial-output disposition, and chain linkage to the paired invocation envelope. Schema version: v0 (initial).

status.description: FR-12.1: terminal stage outcome. 'refused' = construct rejected the invocation pre-execution (e.g., out-of-domain check fired). 'cancelled' = operator-initiated halt. Each enum value has distinct downstream semantics for the stream-graph validator.

uri.description: Path of the produced stream payload (must match output_contract.writes[].destination unless status != success and partial_outputs.disposition allows).

hash.description: Hash of the produced payload at write time. Re-verified by post-exec output validator (SDD §4.4).

primary.description: Domain tag of the produced stream (S0-T8 / FR-11.5: domain attribution).

produced_by.description: Construct slug that produced this output. Cross-checked against construct_slug; mismatch is allowed only when the stage explicitly declares delegation in its output_contract.

outputs.description: Stream outputs the stage actually produced. On status=success, must satisfy invocation envelope's output_contract (post-exec validator).

visible_to_operator.description: If false, summary text is internal-only (audit log + downstream stage). If true, surfaced in operator-facing run report.

text.description: Human-readable stage summary. Bounded length so an entire run summary fits in operator review at a glance.

next_allowed_reads.description: Stream types the next stage is permitted to consume from this stage. Computed by stream-graph validator at composition load; persisted in handoff for replay.

code.description: Bracketed typed error code matching the stream-graph validator and post-exec validator vocabulary (e.g. [STREAM-NO-PRODUCER], [OUTPUT-CONTRACT-VIOLATION], [POLICY-VIOLATION-WRITE], [STAGE-OUT-OF-DOMAIN], [ENVELOPE-CHAIN-BROKEN]).

message.description: Operator-facing diagnostic. Sanitized for credentials/keys per shared lib.

recoverable.description: If true, the run-mode loop may retry the stage; if false, run halts.

error.description: Populated when status != success. Null otherwise.

disposition.description: What the runner did with outputs the stage produced before failing. 'discarded' = deleted. 'quarantined' = moved to .run/quarantine/. 'marked_non_consumable' = retained at original path with marker file so downstream stages refuse to read.

count.description: Number of partial outputs (always 0 on status=success).

prev_hash.description: Links to invocation_hash of the paired invocation envelope (same stage_id + stage_pass). Per SDD §3.1 chain topology: handoff.prev_hash == its_invocation.invocation_hash.

handoff_hash.description: Self-hash. Two-pass: canonicalize envelope WITHOUT this field, sha256, set.

allOf.description: When status is not 'success', error MUST be a populated object.
When status is 'success', error MUST be null and partial_outputs.count MUST be 0.
